methods: all supported scalar and structured comparisons
cases.estimand: Reusable rows for every supported baseline output with complete scientific and execution provenance.
cases.independent_case: A schema audit requires every result variant, including failures and structured scores, to preserve its identifying columns.
cases.divergence: Finite typed result-family matrix uses canonical rows and linked versioned scientific metadata instead of R list columns. Shared JVM/JS CSV retains every admitted row, structured component, failure, count, key, exact time and provenance. Optional JVM-only Arrow 19.0.0 writes the same rows with explicit schema/nullability/units/UTF-8 label policy and bounded owned resources. Actual emitted artifacts are independently read in base R and PyArrow 19.0.1; readers detect corrupted scores. Learned outputs retain a one-ulp runtime difference rather than forcing equal content identities. Existing scientific JSON archives remain authoritative.
